message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in European populations**

| Population group | Minor allele frequency (MAF) |
|------------------|------------------------------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | ~0.13–0.14 |
| Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | ~0.11–0.12 |

These figures come from the Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD), which aggregates exome and genome sequencing data from many studies. The MAF represents the proportion of chromosomes carrying the rs7412 allele in the sampled population.

> **Note:**  
> - Allele frequencies can vary among sub‑populations within Europe (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans).  
> - These numbers are estimates based on available sequencing data and may change as more data become available.  

If you need precise frequencies for a specific sub‑population or study, it’s best to consult the latest gnomAD release or other population‑specific datasets.
